subject: Evaluation kickoff: syncing timelines, trial charter & prompt pack
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@cardioai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evaluation kickoff: syncing timelines, trial charter & prompt pack

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the deep discovery earlier today. Quick recap of what I heard on our call:
- Primary goal: reduce triage time for cardiology reporting by surfacing structured findings (target: 40% reduction).
- Success criteria: precision on key entity extraction (sensitivity >= 0.88 on our core set), <2s median inference latency for 512-token prompts, and stable cost-per-case within the budget you outlined.
- Constraints: PHI in scope, we need audit logs & KMS integration; a private deployment may be required if procurement determines.

Next steps I'd like to propose:
1) Schedule an evaluation kickoff (60–75m) to align the trial charter, confirm success criteria formally, and hand over an initial prompt pack + evaluation plan.
2) Technical deep dive/demo (30–45m) within the same week for your ML/research and infra teams — Ben and Rishi from my side will join.

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue Apr 6: 09:00–10:15 or 13:00–14:15
- Wed Apr 7: 11:00–12:15 or 15:00–16:15

I’ve attached a short trial plan template and a starter prompt pack (v1) so you can see the proposed prompts and evals before the kickoff. If you share any existing test cases or priority patient scenarios, we’ll incorporate them into the prompt set.

Attachments:
- trial_plan_template.xlsx (spreadsheet: success criteria, timeline, roles)
- prompt_pack_v1.json (sample prompts + expected outputs)
- redwood_eval_checklist.pdf (what we'll measure during the trial)

Would any of the windows above work for you? If so, I’ll send a calendar invite with an agenda.

Thanks —
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0189

--
This message is intended for the named recipients only.
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@cardioai.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Patricia Gomez <patricia.gomez@cardioai.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation kickoff: syncing timelines, trial charter & prompt pack

Grace —

Appreciate the summary and the materials. Quick notes:
- The team liked the sample prompts; we'll try to get a few de-identified examples over to you by Monday.
- Patricia (cc'd) is our infra lead — she needs to validate the network/KMS requirements before we confirm private deployment.
- Preferred kickoff: Wed Apr 7, 15:00–16:15 PST works best for the broader team.

One ask: can your tech lead be available for the first 20–30 minutes of the kickoff for a quick architecture alignment? Our goal is to confirm whether a hosted PoC is sufficient or if we need Private/Dedicated from day one.

I'll tentatively hold that slot on our side. Send a calendar invite and any additional agenda items you want us to prep for.

Thanks,
Alex Turner
Head of Product, CardioAI
alex.turner@cardioai.com | +1 (617) 222-4490
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Alex Turner <alex.turner@cardioai.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 09:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation kickoff: syncing timelines, trial charter & prompt pack

Grace / Alex —

Thanks for looping me in. I can join the kickoff and will bring Rishi for the first 25 minutes so we can cover architecture, network constraints, and options (hosted vs dedicated vs private).

Proposed kickoff agenda (45–60m core + 15m admin/follow-ups):
- 0–5m: quick intros, goals for the session (Grace)
- 5–20m: architecture & security constraints (Ben + Rishi)
- 20–40m: trial charter & success criteria (Grace + Alex)
- 40–55m: prompt pack walkthrough and evaluation plan (Grace)
- 55–60m: next steps, owners, calendar for technical deep dive if required

I’ve attached a slightly annotated trial plan template (trial_plan_template.xlsx) with suggested milestone dates and a first-pass owner list. Grace, if you want I can pre-fill Milestone 1 and drop it into the shared Drive before the kickoff.

Attaching:
- trial_plan_template.xlsx (annotated)
- prompt_pack_v1.json

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0147
